operations.description: You can display a list of all orders with the query parameter filter criteria.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] all orders [PATH] v 3 orders [PARAMS] accept auth channel consumer content correlation created customer date end expected from id limit name node order purchase qos sec ship signature sku start status svc timestamp to type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: You can display all released orders that have been created and are ready for fulfilment.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] released orders [PATH] v 3 orders released [PARAMS] accept auth channel consumer content correlation created date id limit name node qos sec ship signature start svc timestamp type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: You can display all released orders that have been created and are ready for fulfilment with nextCursor path parameter.
operations.summary: Get released orders for next page
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] next cursor released orders [PATH] v 3 orders released next cursor [PARAMS] accept auth channel consumer content correlation cursor id name next qos sec signature svc timestamp type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: You can display details of a specific order based on the purchaseOrderId.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] order by purchase order id [PATH] v 3 orders [PARAMS] accept auth channel consumer content correlation id name node order purchase qos sec ship signature svc timestamp type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: You can display a list of all orders with nextCursor path parameter pagination criteria.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] all orders next [PATH] v 3 orders next cursor [PARAMS] accept auth channel consumer content correlation cursor id name next qos sec signature svc timestamp type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: You can acknowledge an entire order, including all of its order lines. Walmart business rules require to acknowledge orders within four hour of receipt of the order, except in extenuating circumstances.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] acknowledge orders [PATH] v 3 orders acknowledge [PARAMS] accept auth channel consumer content correlation id name node order purchase qos sec ship signature svc timestamp type wm [SCHEMA]

operations.description: You can cancel one or more order lines. You must include a purchaseOrderLineNumber when cancelling an order. After cancelling your order, update the inventory for the cancelled order and send it in the next inventory feed.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] cancel order [PATH] v 3 orders cancel [PARAMS] accept auth channel consumer content correlation id name node order purchase qos sec ship signature svc timestamp type wm [SCHEMA] body cancel order request

operations.description: You can refund one or more order lines that have been shipped. The response to a successful call contains the order with the refunded line item.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] refund order [PATH] v 3 orders refund [PARAMS] accept auth channel consumer content correlation id name node order purchase qos sec ship signature svc timestamp type wm [SCHEMA] body cancel order request

operations.description: You can change the status of order lines to "Shipped" and trigger the charge to a customer. You must acknowledge your orders before sending a shipping update to avoid underselling. An order line, once marked as shipped, cannot be updated.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] shipping order [PATH] v 3 orders shipping [PARAMS] accept auth channel consumer content correlation id name node order purchase qos sec ship signature svc timestamp type wm [SCHEMA] body cancel order request
